Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Copper accounts for the largest increase in your explanation—it sounds like recovering genuine input-cost pressure is your main concern. We want to recognise justified cost changes while preserving the stability of our long-standing partnership, using verified movements over comparable periods. How can we balance payment timing and a cost-based price adjustment to make the agreement sustainable for both of us?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €372.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains.
We have reviewed your verified data regarding PPI-C241 and the updated volume forecast, allowing us to adjust our pricing accordingly.
To offer this price reduction, we must maintain our standard 30-day payment terms, as extending to 90 days would necessitate a price increase.
Please note that our pricing parameters are strictly defined by our internal processes, and we do not escalate initial requests to the pricing committee.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €368.42 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.body:

We want a lasting agreement that respects your cost pressures and reflects verified cost movements fairly. On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.31 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.
